tool.mode: Codex built-in image generation with identity references

use.surface: OEDO MARKET 7 / OTOMO RAID 7 game thumbnails
use.characterUsageReason: The OTOMO are the subject of each game thumbnail.

method: Reference images supplied only as identity anchors via codex -i. Pose, angle, scene and background are new; no cutout, crop or background reuse from any reference. Prompts prohibited text, logos, watermarks, UI and human characters.
verification: Both outputs read against their references for colour, face construction, body shape and markings; both cropped to the 960x540 the other game cards use and viewed at ship size.
